finding: Run seed does not propagate to underlying HalfCheetah reset RNG in the retained DPPO wrapper/Gym stack.

evidence.behavior: Wrapper resets inner environment during construction, seeds only global numpy.random, and does not pass a seed to the inner reset.
Gym np_random lazily creates a separate unseeded generator; Wrapper.seed delegates to next wrapper.
Reset samples initial qpos/qvel from self.np_random.
D4RL inherits Gym HalfCheetah and wraps it without repairing seed propagation.

interpretation: A source-level mechanism consistent with pristine initial-return differences, not proof it is the sole cause; no underlying RNG states or initial observations captured.
action: No seeding changes. Apply the approved nondeterministic replay fallback after both probes complete.
